item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:20 HKT 20/Nov/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The weather will be generally fine over southern China today. A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Besides, upper-air disturbances will bring rainy weather to the region midweek this week.

Date/Month: 20/11 (Sunday)
Wind: Northeast force 3 to 4.
Weather: Mainly fine.
Temp range: 23 - 28 C
R.H. range: 60 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 21/11 (Monday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Sunny intervals during the day. One or two rain patches later.
Temp range: 23 - 26 C
R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 22/11 (Tuesday)

Weather: Cloudy with a few showers.
